'''Jan''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] involved in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] plan to start a war between [[S'krrr]] and [[Rabaan]]. He was killed by [[Mika Streev]] on the [[Combat Moon]].<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
